title: Iron Maiden Adds One Last North American Tour Leg for 2027
summary:
Heavy metal band Iron Maiden will return to North America in 2027 for the third and final leg of its Run for Your Lives tour. The tour celebrates the band's 50th anniversary.

The band announced the new dates on Friday, October 16. Iron Maiden had planned to take a break from live shows in 2027. But bassist Steve Harris said the band has been enjoying its current shows in the United States and Canada so much that they changed their plans.

"We all had a chat and decided we should take the show to parts we missed, particularly the North West and South East," Harris said. He said it seemed fair to fans there who have supported the band for many years.

The tour will begin April 14, 2027, at the Tacoma Dome in Tacoma, Washington. It will end May 11 at UBS Arena in Belmont Park, New York. Other stops include Vancouver, Portland, Phoenix, Dallas, Tampa, Atlanta, Raleigh and Hartford.

Two other British bands, Bullet For My Valentine and The Raven Age, will join as special guests. It will be the first time since 1983 that Iron Maiden has toured with two other British bands.

After the tour, the band will play two US music festivals: Sonic Temple in Columbus, Ohio, on May 14, and Boardwalk Rock in Ocean City, Maryland, on May 16. "At festivals you are not just playing to your own fans so it's always a challenge and we all love a challenge!" Harris said.

By the end, the Run for Your Lives tour will have played 107 shows. A press release said these dates "will definitely be the last" of the tour. Iron Maiden is in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.
why_it_matters: It shows how long-lasting bands keep connecting with fans and plan tours around the places where those fans live.
